referral.title: You were pointed here for a reason
referral.body: It's a free IFC health-check that runs entirely in your browser — drag a model in and you get one 0–100 score with the failing elements lit up in 3D. Nothing uploads, and there's nothing to buy. I'd genuinely value your honest read.

standards.title: An on-ramp, not a replacement for bSI
standards.body: Drag an IFC in and you get a single 0–100 Health Score with the failing elements in 3D. It's meant as a fast triage signal that sits alongside IDS and the official validation service — not a conformance claim. I'd value your take on where that line should sit.

feedback.title: One honest question, if you have a sec

q.coordinator: Is a report like this something you'd actually send back to whoever exported the model — or not?
q.dev: Does collapsing all the validation into a single 0–100 number feel useful, or does it hide too much to trust?
q.standards: Does one 0–100 number work as an on-ramp, or does it misrepresent what real IDS/bSI conformance means?

feedback.aside: No form — just reply to my message. Brutally honest is the point.
